svg.title: Drift
svg.script: (()=>{const here=new URL(location.href),parts=here.pathname.split("/"),gh=parts.indexOf("gh");const owner=gh>=0?parts[gh+1]:"",segment=gh>=0?parts[gh+2]:"";const at=segment.indexOf("@"),repo=at>0?segment.slice(0,at):"",ref=at>0?segment.slice(at+1):"";const target=function(next,stamp){const url=new URL(here.href);url.pathname=repo?("/gh/"+owner+"/"+repo+"@"+next+"/index.svg"):here.pathname.replace(/[^/]*$/,"index.svg");url.search="";if(stamp)url.searchParams.set("v",Date.now().toString(36));return url.href};const start=function(next,stamp){location.replace(target(next,stamp))};if(!repo||/^[0-9a-f]{40}$/.test(ref)){start(ref||"main",false);return}const api="https://api.github.com/repos/"+owner+"/"+repo,options={cache:"no-store",headers:{accept:"application/vnd.github+json"}};const read=function(path){return fetch(api+path,options).then(function(response){if(response.status===404)return null;if(!response.ok)throw new Error(String(response.status));return response.json()})};const commitOf=function(data){return data&&data.object&&data.object.type==="commit"&&/^[0-9a-f]{40}$/.test(data.object.sha)?data.object.sha:null};read("/git/ref/heads/"+encodeURIComponent(ref)).then(function(data){return commitOf(data)||read("/git/ref/tags/"+encodeURIComponent(ref)).then(commitOf)}).then(function(sha){return sha||read("/commits/"+encodeURIComponent(ref)).then(function(data){return data&&/^[0-9a-f]{40}$/.test(data.sha)?data.sha:null})}).then(function(sha){start(sha||ref,!sha)}).catch(function(){start(ref,true)})})();
